title: Poland Residence Permit Wait Times (Official)
subtitle: Official voivodeship-office averages from public-information requests
description: Official figures from Polish voivodeship offices on residence-permit processing times (average days), applications and pending cases, obtained by Expat Essentials Poland via public-information requests. Averages, not medians. Cite: Expat Essentials Poland, https://app.expatessentials.pl/wait-times. More: https://expatessentials.pl

resources.description: One row per office, case type and period, with letter reference.
